title: Pre-Operative Chest Radiograph Rate — Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing) Payer Agreements
content:
**Rate clause.** The chest radiograph fee per counted unit for code 71046 under revenue code 0324, on an outpatient surgery Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) whose post-payment denial is refunded on an Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing), is 46.00 USD on a Commercial PPO Claim, 52.00 USD on a Commercial HMO Claim, and otherwise (a Marketplace Exchange Plan Claim) its charges per counted unit times the payer class's expected allowed percentage. The radiograph is valued at its counted units times that rate, never above its charges, its counted units being its billed units, or one when it is billed with charges but no units.

**Hypothetical cases**
| Payer class | Units | Charges | Value |
|---|---|---|---|
| Commercial PPO Claim | 2 | 180.00 | 92.00 |
| Commercial HMO Claim | 2 | 300.00 | 104.00 |
| Commercial HMO Claim | 1 | 40.00 | 40.00 (capped at the charges) |
| Commercial HMO Claim | none billed | 180.00 | 52.00 (one counted unit) |
